import json, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import fuzz, fuzz2

def check_schema(out, doc):
    assert set(out)=={'runs','audits','diagnostic'}, out.keys()
    for r in out['runs']:
        assert set(r)=={'query','profile','rcode','termination','final_name','answer','trace'}, r.keys()
        assert r['rcode'] in ('NOERROR','NXDOMAIN','SERVFAIL','REFUSED')
        assert r['termination'] in ('ANSWER','NODATA','CNAME_STOP','NXDOMAIN','LOOP','LIMIT','OUTSIDE','EXTERNAL')
        assert isinstance(r['trace'],list) and len(r['trace'])>=1
        for a in r['answer']:
            assert set(a)=={'owner','type','data'}, a.keys()
            assert a['type'] in ('A','AAAA','TXT','CNAME')
        # ordering by query then profile
    qs=[r['query'] for r in out['runs']]; ps=[r['profile'] for r in out['runs']]
    assert qs==sorted(qs), 'runs not sorted by query'
    keys=[(r['query'],r['profile']) for r in out['runs']]
    assert keys==sorted(keys) and len(set(keys))==len(keys)
    # coverage
    assert len(out['runs'])==len(doc['queries'])*len(doc['profiles'])
    for a in out['audits']:
        assert set(a)=={'id','verdict','different'}, a.keys()
        assert a['verdict'] in ('match','divergence','unobserved')
        assert isinstance(a['different'],list)
        assert a['different']==sorted(a['different'])
        assert all(x in ('rcode','answer') for x in a['different'])
    ids=[a['id'] for a in out['audits']]
    assert ids==sorted(ids) and len(set(ids))==len(ids)==len(doc['observations'])
    d=out['diagnostic']
    assert set(d)=={'equivalence','basis','cost','count'}
    for c in d['equivalence']:
        assert isinstance(c,list) and c==sorted(c) and len(c)>=1
    assert d['equivalence']==sorted(d['equivalence'])
    assert d['basis']==sorted(set(d['basis']))
    costs={q['id']:q['cost'] for q in doc['queries']}
    assert sum(costs[q] for q in d['basis'])==d['cost']
    assert len(d['basis'])==d['count']
    # partition check
    pids=sorted(p['id'] for p in doc['profiles'])
    flat=sorted(x for c in d['equivalence'] for x in c)
    assert flat==pids, (flat,pids)

if __name__=='__main__':
    n=0
    for gen in (fuzz.gen, fuzz2.gen2):
        for i in range(700):
            rng=random.Random(i*13+5)
            doc=gen(rng)
            p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
            out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
            if 'error' in out: continue
            check_schema(out, doc); n+=1
    print('schema ok for', n, 'documents')
PYEOF
